branch.dirty.zh: 未提交的更改：{count} 个文件

branch.create.en: Create and switch to new branch…

branch.createDialog.title.en: Create and switch to new branch

branch.createDialog.description.en: Create a new local branch from the current HEAD and switch to it immediately.
branch.createDialog.description.zh: 基于当前 HEAD 创建一个新的本地分支，并在创建成功后立即切换过去。

error.conflictsPresent.en: The repository still has unresolved conflicts. Resolve them before switching branches.
error.conflictsPresent.zh: 当前仓库还有未解决的冲突，先处理完再切换分支。

error.operationInProgress.en: Another Git operation is still in progress. Finish it before switching branches.
error.operationInProgress.zh: 当前仓库还有进行中的 Git 操作，完成后再切换分支。

error.branchInOtherWorktree.en: That branch is already checked out in another worktree.
error.branchInOtherWorktree.zh: 目标分支已在其他 worktree 中被检出，当前工作区无法直接切换。

error.trackedOverwrite.en: Switch failed because tracked files would be overwritten: {paths}.
error.trackedOverwrite.zh: 切换失败，以下已跟踪文件的修改会被目标分支覆盖：{paths}。

error.untrackedOverwrite.en: Switch failed because untracked files would be overwritten: {paths}.
error.untrackedOverwrite.zh: 切换失败，以下未跟踪文件会被目标分支覆盖：{paths}。

error.targetBranchNotFound.en: The target branch does not exist locally.
error.targetBranchNotFound.zh: 目标分支不存在于本地仓库。

error.invalidBranchName.en: The branch name is invalid. Enter a different name.
error.invalidBranchName.zh: 分支名无效，请重新输入。

error.branchAlreadyExists.en: That branch already exists. Choose another name.
error.branchAlreadyExists.zh: 分支已存在，请换一个名称。

error.workspaceUnknown.en: This directory is not a registered workspace.
error.workspaceUnknown.zh: 当前目录不是已注册的工作区。

error.internal.en: The operation failed. Please try again.

worktree.create.en: Start a new session in a worktree…
worktree.create.zh: 在 worktree 中开始新会话…

worktree.dialog.title.en: Start a new session in a worktree
worktree.dialog.title.zh: 在 worktree 中开始新会话

worktree.dialog.description.en: Create an isolated worktree in the DSH-managed home ($DSH_HOME/worktrees/) on a new wt/<name> branch, and open a new session in it. The current checkout is untouched.
worktree.dialog.description.zh: 在 DSH 托管目录（$DSH_HOME/worktrees/）创建隔离 worktree，携带新分支 wt/<名称>，并在其中打开新会话。当前检出不受影响。

worktree.manager.forceConfirm.en: This worktree has uncommitted changes. Force-remove it?
worktree.manager.forceConfirm.zh: 该 worktree 有未提交更改，确认强制删除？

error.invalidWorktreeName.en: The worktree name is invalid. Enter a different name.
error.invalidWorktreeName.zh: worktree 名称无效，请重新输入。

error.worktreeAlreadyExists.en: A worktree or branch with that name already exists. Choose another name.
error.worktreeAlreadyExists.zh: 同名 worktree 或分支已存在，请换一个名称。

error.worktreeDirty.zh: 该 worktree 有未提交的更改。

error.worktreeNotFound.en: That worktree was not found (it may already be gone).
error.worktreeNotFound.zh: 找不到该 worktree（可能已被删除）。

error.worktreeIsMain.en: The primary checkout cannot be removed.

error.baseRefNotFound.en: The base branch or revision does not exist.
error.baseRefNotFound.zh: 基线分支或修订不存在。
